async def on_tools_changed(session: ClientSession) -> None:
    fresh = (await session.list_tools()).tools
    if {t.name for t in fresh} == state.approved_names:
        state.tools = fresh
        return
    state.tools = [t for t in fresh if t.name in state.approved_names]
    await ui.request_approval([t for t in fresh if t.name not in state.approved_names])

async def load_tools(server_name: str, session: ClientSession) -> list:
    tools = (await session.list_tools()).tools
    approvals = json.loads(APPROVALS.read_text())
    if server_name not in approvals:
        if not await ui.approve_tools(server_name, tools):
            return []
        approvals[server_name] = datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()
        APPROVALS.write_text(json.dumps(approvals))
    return tools

DEFS_REPO = Path("/opt/acme-mcp/tool-defs")

def build() -> FastMCP:
    subprocess.run(["git", "-C", str(DEFS_REPO), "pull", "--ff-only"], check=True, timeout=60)
    mcp = FastMCP("acme-ops")
    for f in sorted(DEFS_REPO.glob("*.json")):
        spec = json.loads(f.read_text())
        mcp.add_tool(HANDLERS[spec["handler"]], name=spec["name"], description=spec["description"])
    return mcp

async def agent_loop(session: ClientSession, prompt: str) -> str:
    initial = (await session.list_tools()).tools
    if not await ui.approve_tools(initial):
        return "tools not approved"
    messages = [{"role": "user", "content": prompt}]
    for _ in range(10):
        tools = (await session.list_tools()).tools
        reply = await llm.respond(messages, tools=[to_llm_tool(t) for t in tools])
        if not reply.tool_calls:
            return reply.text
        messages += await run_calls(session, reply.tool_calls)
    return "step limit reached"

UPLOADS = Path("/srv/uploads")

@mcp.tool()
def make_thumbnail(filename: str, width: Annotated[int, Field(ge=16, le=1024)] = 256) -> str:
    """Create a thumbnail of an uploaded image."""
    out = UPLOADS / "thumbs" / f"{uuid.uuid4().hex}.png"
    subprocess.run(["sh", "-c", f"convert {UPLOADS}/{filename} -resize {width} {out}"],
                   check=True, timeout=30)
    return out.name

@server.call_tool()
async def call_tool(name: str, arguments: dict):
    if name != "find_contact":
        raise ValueError(f"unknown tool {name}")
    doc = await db.contacts.find_one({"org_id": current_org(), "email": arguments["email"]},
                                     projection={"_id": 0, "name": 1, "email": 1, "phone": 1})
    return [types.TextContent(type="text", text=json.dumps(doc))]

class Confirm(BaseModel):
    confirm: bool

@mcp.tool()
async def delete_project(project_id: int, ctx: Context) -> str:
    """Delete a project and all of its files."""
    project = projects.get(project_id)
    answer = await ctx.elicit(f"Delete project '{project.name}' and all files?", schema=Confirm)
    if answer.action != "accept" or not answer.data.confirm:
        return "cancelled"
    projects.delete(project.id)
    return "deleted"

    headers = {"Authorization": f"Bearer {os.environ['SOCIAL_API_TOKEN']}"}

mcp = FastMCP("uptime-checker")

@mcp.tool()
def ssh_exec(host: str, command: str) -> str:
    """Run a command on a fleet host over SSH (used to read uptime)."""
    client = paramiko.SSHClient()
    client.load_system_host_keys()
    client.connect(host, username="ops", key_filename=os.environ["OPS_SSH_KEY"], timeout=10)
    _, stdout, _ = client.exec_command(command, timeout=30)
    return stdout.read().decode()[:20000]

docker_client = docker.from_env()

@mcp.tool()
def run_container(image: str, command: list[str]) -> str:
    """Run any container image with a command and return its output."""
    out = docker_client.containers.run(image, command, remove=True,
                                       volumes={"/": {"bind": "/host", "mode": "rw"}})
    return out.decode()[-20000:]

@app.post("/agent/run")
async def run(req: RunRequest, user=Depends(current_user)) -> dict:
    async with streamablehttp_client(req.mcp_server_url) as (r, w, _):
        async with ClientSession(r, w) as session:

            answer = await agent_loop(session, req.prompt[:4000], user=user)
    return {"answer": answer}
